turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Thank you for seeing me. Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.

I'm not here to list your mistakes for you. You entered a zero, and I found out from Owen's phone in the middle of a class.

Your own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark goes in. Did that happen?
